components.name: FileIcon
components.description:
Figma `icon-media-file` (Iconography → Special Icons → File): a coloured file shape (Content/Support/…/Light,
Figma uses Background/Support/Violet/Solid) with an On-Colors glyph. Identifies content types — never an action icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Same scale as Icon (Element-Size/Popular); Figma draws it at 20 (base).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative (the file name usually sits next to it).
